 Sariful Sk @ Sher Mahammad Sk

Mr. Debashis Banerjee
 Mr. Rakesh Jana
 ... for the de facto complainant
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits as follows.
The  petitioner is an accused in this case which is under Sections  498A/406/120B/326/307/34 IPC.

By an order dated 13.02.2025  passed by a Division Bench in CRM(DB) 3747 of 2024, the  petitioner was granted bail on the conditions that the petitioner  would appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until  further orders and would not intimidate the witness or tamper with  evidence in any manner whatsoever.

On 25.03.2025 the learned  trial court cancelled the bail of the petitioner even after recording  that the petitioner had been regularly attending Court only on the  ground that there was an allegation of threat made on the victim.

sentences.text: First, it refers  to an incident of 28.02.2025 after a lapse of 13 days that after  getting bail the petitioner was taking information about the victim  and was giving threats in different ways.
It is not even clarified  2 whether the threat was given to the victim and in what day.
At the end only an apprehension is expressed that the petitioner might commit any harm to the victim.
On the basis of the frivolous allegations, the petitioner's bail has been cancelled.
Learned counsel for the de facto complainant opposes the prayer and submits that the impugned order is a well reasoned one and the victim is actually in fear of harm from the petitioner.

A copy of the revisional application be served on the learned counsel for the de facto complainant by today.
 Let the petitioner serve copy of the revisional application upon the State through the learned Public Prosecutor within a week from this date and affidavit of service shall be filed on the next date.
In the meantime, the order of cancellation of bail of the petitioner shall remain stayed till 30.04.2025.
The matter will appear under the same heading on 25.04.2025 for further consideration.
